findings.statement: Package manifest cannot pass completeness: review dispatch/evidence registry artifacts and durable user-decision records are missing.
findings.recommendation: Create dispatch receipt, evidence registry and durable decision records; keep blocked.

findings.statement: S1 is not executable as an implementation package: no adapter, receipt, candidate admission implementation, fixture, oracle or runnable acceptance tests exist.
findings.recommendation: Keep design-only or add an implementation increment with real fixtures and results.

findings.statement: L3 API is underspecified and not directly mappable to existing typed models; identity, scope, versions, errors and normalization are incomplete.
findings.recommendation: Freeze the full interface checklist and normalization rules.

findings.statement: Atomicity and sole-writer claims are not earned; current persistence performs separate writes and no transaction/admission coordinator exists.
Recovery cannot be implemented with current ScholarlyConnector search-only API; invocation identity, receipt state and unknown outcome semantics are absent.
findings.recommendation: Define receipt persistence, replay, timeout, cancellation and restart semantics.

findings.statement: Parity evidence is only a plan; no fixture, oracle, comparison tool or result artifact exists.
findings.recommendation: Add frozen fixture/oracle and field-level comparison artifact.

findings.statement: Skill/MCP trust and authorization are intentions, not enforceable contracts; manifest schema, scope model and provenance checks are absent.
findings.recommendation: Narrow S1 to trusted adapters or define manifest/scope/isolation contract.

findings.statement: Evidence admission lacks typed candidate/admission receipt, rejection, dedupe, invalidation and audit transaction semantics.
findings.recommendation: Add bounded admission contract and tests.

findings.statement: Projection/checkpoint ownership still lacks ordering, rebuild and conflict policy.
findings.recommendation: Clarify in L2; keep non-blocking if S1 does not alter projections.

findings.statement: No durable record proves material user decisions although manifest marks user_decisions pass.
findings.recommendation: Record actor, timestamp, alternatives and approval/delegation provenance or set pending.

steelman.strongest_support: This package is materially better than prior samples: it separates Runtime, capability adapters and Evidence, includes distinct construction/dependency/interaction views, and adds a concrete L3 candidate.
steelman.strongest_opposition: It still presents target contracts without executable proof artifacts, so it is a design draft rather than an implementation-ready package.
fact_checks: application.py still wires the system in one initializer.
search_service.py and storage.py lack an admission transaction boundary.
removed_decisions: No claim of arbitrary Skill/MCP pluggability or S1 readiness
changed_boundaries: S1 must remain design-only until fixtures/L3/recovery exist
trust boundary must be narrowed or specified
